name: Status Extension Request Notification V 03
definition: Scope|The StatusExtensionRequestNotification message is sent by the matching application to the party requested to accept or reject a request to extend the status of a transaction.|This message is used to notify the request to extend the status of a transaction.|Usage|The StatusExtensionRequestNotification message can be sent by the matching application to pass on information about the request to extend the status of a transaction that it has obtained through the receipt of a StatusExtensionRequest message.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.|This identification is to be used in any communication between the parties.|.

EstablishedBaselineIdentification.name: Established Baseline Identification
EstablishedBaselineIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the baseline when it is established.

UserTransactionReference.name: User Transaction Reference
UserTransactionReference.definition: Reference to the transaction for each financial institution which is a party to the transaction.

StatusToBeExtended.name: Status To Be Extended
StatusToBeExtended.definition: Identifies the status for which an extension of the validity period has been requested.

Initiator.name: Initiator
Initiator.definition: Party that has requested the status extension.

RequestForAction.name: Request For Action
RequestForAction.definition: Information on the next processing step required.
